thread:
mia_support: Customer (CustCorp) reports 401 `invalid_api_key` when calling /v1/embeddings. They created the key in the dashboard a few minutes ago, copied it into their GitHub Actions secret and tried a simple curl.

alice_cust: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -> 401 {\"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"Invalid API key\"}}

sam_cs: Asked if they rotated any keys earlier today or if org has SSO policies. Customer says their SSO session timed out while they were in the dashboard but they still saw the key value after hitting "create".

mia_support: Reproduced with the masked key on our side -> same 401. Attached audit trace we pulled for CustCorp: `event: api_key.create id=ak_abc123 status=pending_approval actor=alice@custcorp.com policy=require_admin_approval`.

raj_infra: That status is important — org has the new "require_admin_approval_for_api_keys" setting enabled. If a non-admin creates a key, server marks it `pending_approval` and doesn't activate it yet. UI currently shows the secret but backend prevents usage until an admin explicitly approves.

cleo_prodsec: Agreed. We should return a clearer error for that case. Current generic 401/invalid_api_key hides the real cause and makes support work harder. Recommend returning 401 with subcode `key_pending_approval` and a human hint: "Key created but awaiting admin approval (see Organization > API keys)".

sam_cs: For now, mitigation steps sent to customer: 1) ask their Org Admin to approve the key under Settings → API Keys OR 2) admin create an approved key and paste into Actions secrets. Also suggested they avoid sharing the key in logs until approved.

alice_cust: Admin approved the key and we retried — success. Embeddings call returned 200. Thanks!

mia_support: Marking as resolved with root cause = org policy + created-by-non-admin. Filing follow-up ticket to update error message and add a small UI tooltip when showing keys created while pending.

ops-bot: ticket #RED-1428 created -> prodsec/infra to triage; priority P2.

raj_infra: I'll pick up the backend change to surface `pending_approval` in the error response and add telemetry for audit logs (should surface org_policy field). Cleo, can you review security implications? If not needed, we'll schedule in this sprint.

cleo_prodsec: Will review. Also suggest adding an audit log filter for "pending" keys so support can quickly find these during escalation.

mia_support: Action items: (1) send KB note to customer-facing docs about this SSO-approved-key flow, (2) follow-up PR for clearer error, (3) add quick internal runbook entry. Closing thread once PR merged.

sam_cs: Customer happy, leaving a :white_check_mark: reaction and telling them to ping if anything else crops up.

mia_support: Closing.
